answer: A gale of fresh wallets is a sybil farm's favourite weather. Quadratic funding scores a ballot on the square root of its backers' stakes: $100 from a hundred people draws $9,900, while $100 from one wallet draws nothing. The cluster check is the kill-shot: 10,000 ballots from one wallet share one funding graph, and at their nadir the match collapses to zero — every ballot rejected. Each backer first earns a Human Passport score — weeks of stamps. Gitcoin proved it: $60 million to 3,700 projects, thousands of fakes stripped per round. A walnut cracks once; hollow shells crack the same way.
